translation: They will want respect and gain. With a mind wanting to look around, they will become close to householders. After leaving the teaching, they will do things against the teaching. Leaving the path and going on a wrong path is Mara's work.

Chapter Seven: Showing complete awakening in a single instant.

Having fully perfected these qualities, that bodhisattva
translation:
Chapter Seven: Showing full awakening in one moment.

After fully perfecting these qualities, that awakening hero...

Chapter Eight: Showing the teaching body.

They fully embrace a perfectly pure land and pure living beings. They fully embrace the line of Buddhas and the line of the teaching. In the same way, they fully embrace the lineage of the community and all qualities.
